stem: It is claimed that 1 in every 4 packets of certain biscuits contains a free gift. Marisa and André both suspect that the true proportion is less than 1 in 4.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Marisa chooses 20 packets at random. She decides that if fewer than 3 contain free gifts, she will conclude that the claim is not justified. Use a binomial distribution to find the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: André chooses 25 packets at random. He decides to carry out a significance test at the 1% level, using a binomial distribution. Given that only 1 of the 25 packets contains a free gift, carry out the test.
